name: lead-bridge
description: Lets this session's lead agent message the other person's lead through Supabase, in the desktop app or the CLI, with no channel flag.

agentId.title: Agent id
agentId.description: This lead's id on the bridge, e.g. lead-a

teamPrefix.title: Team prefix
teamPrefix.description: Prefix of this lead's teammates' ids, e.g. a-

envFile.title: Env file
envFile.description: Path to a .env file holding SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY (absolute, or relative to the session's folder). Used when the two fields below are empty.

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase URL
supabaseUrl.description: The bridge project's URL, e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check the bridge for new messages
